description: `renderKanbanCard()` at `plans/overview.html:1335-1336` honors `cardData.order` (numeric) by appending the card directly, ignoring `cardData.insertBeforeTaskId` when both are set. The schema in the data file lists both fields on the same card entries (e.g., perf-WS3 carries `insertBeforeTaskId: '3a-skills'` AND `order: 30`). So `insertBeforeTaskId` is dead data on every order-having card and live data on no-order cards. The final layout is consistent (sort-by-order runs before insertBefore-by-anchor), but the schema invites confusion: future bookkeepers will set `insertBeforeTaskId` thinking it matters when paired with `order`. No bug, but a documentation gap.
suggestedFix: Document the precedence in the SKILL.md schema reference: `order` (when present) is authoritative and `insertBeforeTaskId` is the fallback anchor for cards without `order`. Alternatively, strip `insertBeforeTaskId` from order-having entries in `plans/overview-data.js` so the data reflects what the renderer actually consumes.
